newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai 1997 rice exports seen at 5.0 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Thai 1997 rice exports seen at 5.0 mln tonnes.

text.p: Thailand projected that rice exports this year will fall short of the target of 5.5 million tonnes, reaching only 5.0 million tonnes, a senior commerce ministry official said on Sunday.
Pracha Charutrakulchai, the commerce ministry's director general of foreign trade department, attributed the slowdown of rice export to lower global demand for rice.
"According to world foods organisation's estimate, the world rice trade this year will fall to 17 million tonnes from 19 million tonnes last year," Pracha said.
He said Thailand has no problem with the high-quality rice, but is facing more competition from lower-cost producers in lower quality markets.
Pracha said China remains Thailand's major market for top quality rice, while there are more buying interest from the Middle East and Africa.
The government is ecouraging the industry to produce good-quality rice and at the same time will look for more low-quality rice markets for exporters, he said.
